name: AskGo: Use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini Together
description:

💡 AskGo provides you with a one-stop solution!

🔥 Why choose AskGo?
✅ A continuously updated cutting-edge AI think tank — GPT, DeepSeek, Gemini, Claude, Grok, etc., to fully meet your needs.

✅ Built-in multiple AI tools powered by top large models, enabling one-click PPT creation, data analysis, document reading, e-commerce image set design, and more.
✅ Supports document chat, intelligent search, and academic search, helping you quickly obtain essential information.

💻 How to use:
🔸 Click the "Get" button and pin it to the toolbar.

🔸 Start chatting with AskGo!
